name: Mistral AI
description: Paris-based AI company developing open-weight frontier models, enterprise AI products, and infrastructure. Mistral positions its full-stack platform around sovereign AI, giving enterprises and governments greater control over models, data, compute, and deployment.
Investors: Samsung Electronics (lead), Scaleup Europe Fund/EQT (co-lead), PSG Equity (co-lead), Advent, BlackRock, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, a16z, ASML, Belfius, BNP Paribas CIB, Bpifrance, Carmignac, DST Global, Eurazeo, General Catalyst, Headline, Hillspire, Index Ventures, Korelya Capital, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Phoenix Court, Salesforce Ventures
Founder: Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample, Timothée Lacroix

name: The Exploration Company
description: Franco-German space company developing reusable and refillable spacecraft to transport cargo to and from space stations in low-Earth orbit. Its flagship Nyx vehicle is designed to provide Europe and international customers with an independent space transportation capability.
Investors: Bessemer Venture Partners (lead), Atomico (lead), Scaleup Europe Fund/EQT (lead), Balderton Capital, Plural, Cherry Ventures

name: Implicity
description: Developer of a manufacturer-neutral platform that centralizes data from connected cardiac devices and helps care teams prioritize remote-monitoring alerts, workflows, and billing.

name: Arlequin AI
description: Developer of topological neural-network models and data-analysis software designed to uncover complex relationships across fragmented datasets for government and enterprise users.
Investors: Redalpine, OTB Ventures, Bpifrance Fonds Innovation Défense, Vsquared Ventures, 10x Founders, Xavier Niel

name: Actionable
description: Predictive customer-experience platform that models enterprise customer journeys and uses AI to identify churn, dissatisfaction, complaints, and repeat-purchase risk across an entire customer base.

name: Olenbee
description: Employee-benefits platform using open banking and AI to identify eligible purchases on employees' personal bank accounts, enabling employers to reimburse meal vouchers, gift vouchers, and other benefits directly.
Investors: Go Capital, Bpifrance, European Regional Development Fund (ERDF), Business Angels
Founder: Arnaud Martenat, Olivier Berthommier, François Roulin, Gonzague Bourrut Lacouture

name: Ed.ai
description: AI assistant for teachers that pre-corrects student work, identifies individual and class-wide learning gaps, and generates personalized remediation materials.
Investors: Bpifrance Digital Venture (lead), La Poste Ventures, 50 Partners, AFI Ventures, CentraleSupélec Venture, Ring Capital Generations, Super Capital
Founder: Jonathan Banon, Cédric Bignon, Rémi Mazières

name: Tellia
description: Voice AI platform for agriculture that turns phone calls, voice notes, WhatsApp messages, texts, photos, and emails from field teams into structured operational data. Tellia connects information to the right fields, crops, crews, and operations, and is building an agentic layer that integrates with existing agricultural software.
Investors: Revent, Grey Silo Ventures, Jeriko, Fund F
Founder: Coline Labadie de Faÿ, Vincent Trastour

name: Outline
description: AI-powered financial-planning platform for SMEs and mid-market companies, connecting accounting, billing, payroll, and sales data so finance teams can build forecasts and scenario simulations in natural language.
Investors: Founders Future (lead), 100IN, Newschool, Bruno Vaffier, Antoine Lizée, Raphaël Nahum, business angels

name: Bob! Desk
description: SaaS platform for managing technical interventions, maintenance requests, and service providers across multi-site property portfolios, retail networks, and other distributed operations. A cloud-based CMMS/GMAO that centralizes tickets, scheduling, communications, and maintenance tracking.

name: ANA Healthcare
description: Developer of on-premises clinical data software that collects, structures, and anonymizes hospital clinical and imaging data, turning fragmented health information into research-ready cohorts for hospitals, researchers, and healthcare industry partners.
Investors: Région Sud Investissement, CAAP Création, Business Angels

name: V4Cure
description: CEA spinout developing synthetic peptide-based treatments for severe kidney and liver-related conditions, led by its preclinical candidate V4C-232.
Investors: New business angels and existing investors (undisclosed)
Founder: Nicolas Gilles, Sonia Escaich, Nabil Gharios

name: Paradigme
description: Paris-based second-hand fashion platform combining a B2C marketplace with white-label resale services for fashion brands and retailers. Consumers can trade in clothing for gift cards usable with partner brands, while Paradigme manages resale. It is also developing AI Studio, which automatically generates product imagery and listings for fashion companies.
Investors: Hartwood, One Green, Pelintex, Showroomprivé, Business Angels

name: Quiet
description: Manufacturer of noise-reducing tableware for collective catering, combining tempered glass with a patented silicone coating. Quiet says its products cut impact noise by 85% while being lighter, more resistant, and recyclable than conventional ceramic tableware.
Founder: Pierre Busquet, Sébastien Chauvin, Sophie Moritel

name: OTEO
description: Annecy-based startup helping hospitals deploy and manage Hébergement Temporaire Non Médicalisé (HTNM), or hospital hotels. Its platform handles patient eligibility, hotel reservations, administration, and reimbursement, alongside consulting and implementation services for healthcare providers.
Investors: makesense, 50 Partners, INSEAD, Business Angels, BADGE, Bpifrance, Crédit Agricole des Savoie, CIC

name: BlueSecure
description: Cybersecurity-awareness platform combining interactive training, serious games, and simulated attacks to help employees recognize threats.
Investors: Paris Business Angels, Arts & Métiers Business Angels, Bpifrance
